headline: Zenith Bank Looks Cheaper While GTCO Looks Safer, Analysis Shows
summary: An analysis of Guaranty Trust Holding Company and Zenith Bank reveals that despite posting nearly similar nine-month pre-tax profits, the two Nigerian banks employ different approaches to generating revenue.
why: Comparative financial analysis of major commercial banks helps institutional investors assess valuation disparities, risk profiles, and profitability metrics in frontier banking sectors.
